title: Argentinian Frittata with Oozy Egg
description: A twist on the classic Italian dish, this Argentinian-inspired frittata features oozy eggs and a flavorful blend of ingredients.
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add Argentinian diced ham or chorizo.
Cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
Add Oozy to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour whisked eggs over the skillet mixture and cook until almost set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the eggs are fully set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a minute or two.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
